data.name: Saamir
data.gender_notes: Saamir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Sa-mara’, which means ‘one who conquers’ or ‘one who is victorious’. It is a powerful name that signifies strength, courage, and the ability to overcome challenges. The name Saamir carries the meaning “Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Saamir usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saamir is a divine name that is associated with the Hindu god Lord Shiva. It is believed that this name bestows the blessings of Lord Shiva, who is the god of destruction and transformation. Saamir is a name that inspires courage, strength, and the ability to overcome obstacles.

historical_references.reference: According to Hindu mythology, Saamir was the name of a sage who is said to have lived during the Treta Yuga. He was a great devotee of Lord Vishnu and is believed to have attained Moksha (liberation) by pleasing the deity with his devotion.

Another reference to Saamir comes from the epic Mahabharata where he is mentioned as a charioteer of Arjuna during the Kurukshetra war. He is also known as Saatwat, and his story is narrated in the Bhagavad Gita.
